description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled.

An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller, using the Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC), aka Netlogon Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Zerologon).

A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Remote Desktop Services when an unauthenticated attacker connects to the target system using RDP and sends specially crafted requests, aka Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (BlueKeep).

Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges, install programs, view/change data, or create new accounts with full user rights.

affected_product: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server
description: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server versions allow an unauthenticated attacker to create unauthorized administrator accounts and gain full administrative access to publicly accessible Confluence instances.

In affected versions of Confluence Server and Data Center, an OGNL injection vulnerability exists that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on a Confluence Server or Data Center instance via URI parameter handling.

Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (ProxyLogon). A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to send HTTP requests and authenticate as the Exchange server.
Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (ProxyNotShell). An authenticated attacker could trigger a remote code execution chain when combined with PowerShell backend SSRF.

affected_product: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway (Citrix Bleed)
description: Sensitive information disclosure in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway when configured as an Authorization Gateway allows unauthenticated session token exfiltration to hijack authenticated active sessions.

affected_product: Citrix NetScaler ADC / Gateway Unauthenticated RCE
description: Unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

affected_product: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN (Volt Typhoon / Heap Overflow)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (MonikerLink). An attacker sending a crafted email with a file:// link bypassing Protected View can trigger NTLM credential leaks and arbitrary code execution.

affected_product: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT / Follina)
description: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Follina). An attacker can call MSDT using the URL protocol from an application such as Word to run arbitrary code with the calling process privileges.
Spring Framework RCE via Data Binding on JDK 9+. A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding using class loader access.

Apache ActiveMQ OpenWire protocol implementation allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to run arbitrary shell commands by manipulating serialized class types in OpenWire protocol.

In Progress MOVEit Transfer before 2021.0.6, a SQL injection vulnerability has been found in the MOVEit Transfer web application that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to database contents and execute arbitrary code.

ConnectWise ScreenConnect 23.9.7 and prior contains an Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to access the setup wizard and create administrator accounts.
A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the expected document root.

affected_product: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST Authentication Bypass
description: On F5 BIG-IP versions, undiscloseable iControl REST authentication bypass vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the BIG-IP system through the management port or self IP to execute arbitrary system commands.

affected_product: F5 BIG-IP TMUI Remote Code Execution
description: In BIG-IP versions, the Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI), also referred to as the Configuration utility, has a Remote Code Execution vulnerability in undisclosed pages.

affected_product: Zyxel IKE Packet Processing Command Injection
description: Improper error message handling in the IKE packet decoder of Zyxel firewall firmware versions could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands by sending crafted packets to UDP port 500.

affected_product: OpenSSL TLS Signature NULL Pointer Dereference
description: An OpenSSL TLS server may crash if sent a maliciously crafted renegotiation ClientHello message. If a TLSv1.2 renegotiation ClientHello omits the signature_algorithms extension, a NULL pointer dereference will occur resulting in DoS.

In PHP versions 8.0.*, 8.1.*, 8.2.*, when loading phar file, while reading directory entries, directory name is not verified for directory length, resulting in buffer overflow and potential remote code execution.

affected_product: Microsoft Exchange Server Static Validation Key Memory Corruption
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server when the server fails to properly create unique cryptographic validation keys at install time, allowing an authenticated user to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM rights.

affected_product: Apple iOS / macOS Kernel State Manipulation (Operation Triangulation)
description: An app may be able to modify sensitive kernel state. Apple addressed this issue with improved state management for Operation Triangulation exploits.

affected_product: Windows Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS PetitPotam)
description: Windows Local Security Authority (LSA) Spoofing Vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could coerce a domain controller to authenticate against an arbitrary NTLM relay destination (PetitPotam).

An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists due to overly permissive Access Control Lists (ACLs) on multiple system files, including the Security Account Manager (SAM) database, allowing low-privileged users to read administrative hashes.

A flaw was found in the way the flags member of the new pipe buffer structure was not properly initialized in copy_page_to_iter_pipe and push_pipe functions in the Linux kernel, allowing overwriting of read-only cached page memory.

A local privilege escalation vulnerability was found on polkit's pkexec utility. The pkexec application does not properly validate the number of command-line arguments, allowing an unprivileged user to execute code as root.

affected_product: Microsoft Outlook NTLM Credential Stealing via MAPI Reminder
description: Microsoft Outlook Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability. An attacker can send a crafted calendar reminder item containing a PidLidReminderFileParameter UNC path, coercing the client to send NTLM hashes over SMB without user interaction.
